description_en: This three-bayed narrow Phalcāwith simple 19th century pillars is located at Cvachẽ Square, between Cyāsal in the east and Bhelāchẽ in the west. ASaṃkha Bahālhas been built by the Avāles caste, and apañcāvali caityastands in front (to the east) of Cvachẽ Phalcā. Next to it is the Gaṇeśa Phalcā (LAL4143, SW) and Śaṃkha Bāhāḥ Sattaḥ (NW). The western side of Cvachẽ Phalcā is attached to the wall of Sānulāl Avāle's house.
description_ne: यो तीन वटा कवल र १९ औँ शताब्दीमा बनेका सादा काष्ठस्तम्भ भएको साँघुरो फल्चा पूर्वपट्टि च्यासल र पश्चिमपट्टि भेलाछेँको बीचमा च्वछेँ चौबाटोमा टोलको स्वामित्वमा रहेको छ । यो फल्चा गणेश फल्चाको दक्षिणपश्चिम र शङ्ख बाहा सत्तःको उत्तरपश्चिमपट्टि रहेको छ । पश्चिमपट्टि यो फल्चा सानुलाल अवालेको घरको इनारसँग जोडिएको छ ।
monument_assessment: Slightly damaged (minor damages such as minor cracks, plants, missing stones in plinths)

historical_events.event_description: Cvachẽ Phalcā was renovated using a donation of 90,000 Nep. Rupees. These funds were donated by Urban Development Through Local Effort (udle) and GTZ, and bricks were donated by a kiln. The local people assisted in the reconstruction as volunteers. The original beams and pillars were kept.
